title: Leukocyte–pulse coupling and inflammation: a cross-cycle incremental-prediction test
abstract: A leukocyte-count by resting-pulse interaction changed held-out weighted log-CRP MSE by -0.000741 across NHANES2007-2008 to2009-2010; joint design-bootstrap95% [-0.002829,+0.002968]. The registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met. This is an inconclusive/negative result, not evidence of equivalence. Flexible sex-specific standard-measure comparators and author sensitivity checks were used. Independent recruitment cycles share a survey platform; reused benchmarks are not untouched confirmation. No novel biological mechanism or clinical use is established.
